name: team_planning_set_rule
description: Set one rule in a scenario of a Team Planning plan, by its name from tenants_planning_rules, for the whole plan or, with unit_id, for that unit and the units below it. value is an object in the shape that rule's value_schema gives, and replaces the value above it whole. Steps after the scenario, and its alternatives, inherit it unless they change it. To follow the parent again, use team_planning_clear_change with facet 'rule:<name>'. A refusal names what is wrong, never the value. Refused unless the caller is one of the plan's editors. `note` is Markdown: links, **bold**, _italic_, lists and `code` render, a bare URL becomes a link, typed HTML shows as text and images render as links.

note.description: Why this is in the plan, such as the business reason for a move. Optional, at most 2000 characters; it never changes what the scenario resolves to. A note on a change to a person goes when they are forgotten. Any other note, such as one on a unit, a position or a rule, stays until the plan is deleted, so keep personal details out of it.

scenario_id.description: The scenario, or the plan's id for the baseline.

unit_id.description: Omit to set the rule for the whole plan.
